title: atalanthus resedifolius
intro: Atalanthus resedifolius, commonly known as Mountain Gold, is a plant species in the family Gentianaceae. It is a perennial herb used in traditional medicine, particularly in the Caribbean region. The health benefits of Atalanthus resedifolius include its antifungal, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may aid in the treatment of various infections and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily triterpenoids, flavonoids, and saponins, which exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
